detail.command:
set -e
printf '%s\n' '=== STATUS ==='
git status --short
printf '%s\n' '=== OBSTACLES TREE ==='
if [ -d src/obstacles ]; then find src/obstacles -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort; else echo 'NO_OBSTACLES_DIR'; fi
printf '%s\n' '=== OBSTACLES PREVIEW ==='
if [ -d src/obstacles ]; then for f in $(find src/obstacles -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sort); do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,220p' "$f"; done; fi
